title: ADR-0141 D7: record that its first consumer (HotCRM revenue as its own artifact) is shelved; HotCRM ships as one suite with modules disabled in settings
body:
domain:spec#4 · marchtian · session_017ihL2eAG5J8aqAyPZif4BJ

Filing gate: ③ the maintainer's order, verbatim: 「A」 (2026-11-08 04:12Z UTC, decision #26986 Q0) and 「按照这个方案修订相关的任务」 (04:12Z UTC), in the marchtian account's project; ruling record objectstack-ai/objectstack#26986 comment 6717108024.
Reader: the `domain:skills` lane (`docs/adr/**`, Tier H), next PR that touches `docs/adr/0141-inter-app-dependency-declared-checked-before-install.md`.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "ADR-0141 addendum revenue" → 6 hits, none an ADR edit (#26986, #25792, #25403, #28117 closed; #12708, #6015 seat posts); "ADR-0141 first consumer" → 18 hits, none proposes this edit.
Business reason: ADR-0141 D7 still says "The first consumer is a HotCRM module shipping on its own, revenue first", and the TL;DR repeats it. The maintainer has now ruled that this shape is not a target: HotCRM ships as one suite artifact and a customer turns modules off in settings (#25805 ruling D, #28117 ruling A). An agent reading ADR-0141 today would plan hotcrm#2271's carve-out work as the platform's direction. ⛔ The record must not keep pointing at a shelved consumer.

## Owed

1. An addendum on ADR-0141 (TL;DR sentence and §D7 header note), dated, citing #26986's ruling: the standalone-revenue consumer is shelved; the shipped shape is one artifact with module disable (#25805 D, #28117 A); the D2/D5 machinery stays as declared for a future cross-artifact consumer, which reopens #26986's Q1–Q5 (deferred, not rejected) and #25805.
2. Nothing else in the record changes: no decision is reversed, and the open section stays open "decided with the first consumer", whoever that becomes.

**Level:** ADR prose only, Tier H (maintainer approval before landing). No code, no changeset.

Related: #26986 (ruling 6717108024, measurement 6716259819), #25805, #28117, hotcrm#2271.
